Some things in life are worth slowing down for, and our Luxury Wagyu Biltong is one of them. We take premium Wagyu beef, dry-cure it with salt, coriander and vinegar, then slow-air-dry it the traditional South African way until the flavour runs deep and the texture is beautifully firm. It's the biltong that elevates a Sunday braai, a long road trip or a quiet glass of red into something properly special. Our regulars tell us one pack is never enough, which is why it comes in 500g and 1kg sizes. From R650, it's a little taste of luxury, proudly made for Mzansi and delivered straight to your door. So tell us, are you a 500g taster or a 1kg committer? Drop your answer in the comments below, we love hearing how South Africa snacks.
